bioconda.name: bioconductor-seqarray
bioconda.summary: Data management of large-scale whole-genome sequence variant calls using GDS files

biotools.summary: Data management of large-scale whole-genome sequencing variant calls with thousands of individuals: genotypic data (e.g., SNVs, indels and structural variation calls) and annotations in SeqArray GDS files are stored in an array-oriented and compressed manner, with efficient data access using the R programming language.
